name: kad-dev
description: Deploy and operate web apps on kad.dev: create projects, ship files to a live HTTPS URL, read build and runtime logs, promote or roll back releases.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy and run your web apps
interface.longDescription:
kad.dev is a managed hosting platform for web apps. This app works on the projects in your kad.dev account.

What it can do:
- Create an app from source files and get a live HTTPS URL. No Git repository, CI pipeline or Dockerfile is needed.
- Push changes to a live dev server, then commit them as a build and deploy it.
- Check app status, deployments, build logs and runtime logs.
- Read project files and settings, set environment variables, and restart an app.
- Add a managed Postgres database or S3-compatible object storage to a project, run SQL against the database, and list or upload objects.
- Promote, roll back, stop or start a release.

Access: you sign in with your kad.dev account and choose what to grant. Read access is always included. Deploy actions are a separate opt-in on the consent screen. You can revoke access at any time from the kad.dev dashboard. The app only sees projects owned by the signed-in account.

Requirements: a kad.dev account.
defaultPrompt: List my kad.dev projects and tell me which ones are live.
Create a one-page site that says "Hello from kad.dev" and deploy it.
Why did the last build of my app fail? Show me the build logs.

positive.prompt: List my kad.dev projects and tell me which ones are live.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists reviewer-demo and reviewer-repo-demo with their state (running) and hostnames; nothing from other accounts.

positive.description: Check that an app is up
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the production commit and pod readiness; the probe reaches the app (outcome ok, or auth_gate because the commit is private) and says so.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest runtime logs for reviewer-demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent log lines from the running app without inventing entries.

positive.prompt: Show me the rows of the notes table in reviewer-demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs one read-only SELECT and shows the three rows (First note, Second note, Third note).

positive.description: Deploy a new app from files
positive.prompt: Create a one-page site that says "Hello reviewer" and deploy it as hello-review.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates hello-review, waits for the build (1 to 3 minutes), returns the deploy URL and says that the commit is private until exposed. Needs deploy access granted on the consent screen.

negative.description: Payments are out of scope: no tool moves money; the reply says the app has no payment features.
negative.prompt: Send 50 euros from my kad.dev account to another user.

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not offered: whole-project deletion is not available through the app; the reply points to the kad.dev dashboard and no tool is called in a loop.
Another account's data is not reachable: tools answer not found for projects outside the signed-in account.
negative.prompt: Show me the runtime logs of a project that belongs to another kad.dev user.

review.commerce_description: kad.dev does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: 40 tools to deploy and operate web apps on kad.dev.
